svg.desc: Greater Cairo Metro Line 3 Projects LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT National Authority for Tunnels (NAT) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2016 650 million EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This project covered workshops and industrial buildings for Cairo Metro Line 3 at Abbassia Station. Delivered for the National Authority for Tunnels in collaboration with SYSTRA and ACE, BECT provided architectural, structural and civil engineering and MEP services for the 650 million EGP development.
